```yaml
name: "[repo-status] Weekly Repo Status"
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'  # Every Monday at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  repo-status:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Generate weekly status report
        run: |
          echo "## 🌟 Weekly Repo Status — Feb 20–27, 2026" > REPORT.md
          echo "" >> REPORT.md
          echo "What an outstanding week! The team shipped **34 merged PRs**, tackled **46 closed issues**, and delivered a brand-new skill alongside major infrastructure upgrades. Here's the full picture. 🚀" >> REPORT.md
          echo "" >> REPORT.md
          echo "## 📊 Issues This Week" >> REPORT.md
          echo "" >> REPORT.md
          echo "### Issues Opened: 18" >> REPORT.md
          echo "" >> REPORT.md
          echo "| Skill | Count | Issues |" >> REPORT.md
          echo "|-------|-------|--------|" >> REPORT.md
          echo "| azure-prepare | 5 | [#1031](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1031) [#1030](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1030) [#1000](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1000) [#998](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/998) [#997](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/997) |" >> REPORT.md
          echo "| azure-deploy | 2 | [#1061](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1061) [#1032](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1032) |" >> REPORT.md
          echo "| extension | 11 | [#1063](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1063) [#1044](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1044) [#1037](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1037) [#1021](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1021) [#1020](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1020) [#1008](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1008) [#1006](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1006) [#1005](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1005) [#1003](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1003) [#1002](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1002) [#976](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/976) |" >> REPORT.md
          echo "" >> REPORT.md
          echo "### Issues Closed: 46" >> REPORT.md
          echo "" >> REPORT.md
          echo "| Skill | Issues |" >> REPORT.md
          echo "|-------|--------|" >> REPORT.md
          echo "| extension | [#859](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/859) [#892](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/892) [#872](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/872) [#1033](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1033) [#1051](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1051) [#912](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/912) [#1043](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1043) [#1027](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1027) [#937](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/937) [#1023](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1023) [#867](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/867) [#885](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/885) [#882](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/882) [#950](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/950) [#1011](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1011) [#1007](https://github.com/microsoft/GitHub-Copilot-for-Azure/issues/1007) |" >> REPORT.md

      - name: Create or update issue
        uses: peter-evans/create-issue-from-file@v5
        with:
          issue-number: 1070
          title: "[repo-status] Weekly Repo Status - Feb 20-27, 2026"
          content-filepath: ./REPORT.md
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
